themes.title: Government Economic Intervention & Sectoral Impact
themes.blurb: Right-wing coverage across Norway and the United States focuses on how government financial decisions, interest rates, and regulatory fees impact working households and specific economic sectors. In Norway, FrP criticizes rate hikes and industry fees, while in the US, coverage addresses state-level legal challenges against federal policy shifts in the energy sector.
